title: Build a Custom Iterator
question: Create an iterator that counts from one to three.
code:
class CountToThree:
    def __init__(self): self.value = 0
    def __iter__(self): return self
    def __next__(self):
        if self.value == 3: raise StopIteration
        self.value += 1
        return self.value
print(list(CountToThree()))
